capabilities: chat with answers grounded in selected notes, folders, PDFs, and images
generate multiple-choice, short-answer, and essay quizzes with model grading
generate term/definition flashcards and run self-scored review sessions
switch providers and models on the fly, including Gemini and Claude CLI logins
open Google NotebookLM in the sidebar or browser
disambiguation: Not a multi-agent orchestrator; it is one assistant sidebar whose backend can be pointed at different AI providers.
extras: Not yet in the community store; requires manual installation of four files including pdf.worker.min.js (without it, PDF reading fails). API keys are stored in plain text in data.json. The Gemini CLI provider runs with --approval-mode yolo, granting it file access and web search without prompting. Quiz and flashcard content can be generated in English, Korean, or both.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ground AI chat, quizzes, or flashcards in selected vault content, or to switch between multiple AI providers from one panel.

relations.evidence: The NotebookLM tab embeds notebooklm.google.com in an iframe on desktop.
